primitives.name: Haar Measure Invariance
primitives.verbatim_quote: The main purpose of the following discussion of measurable groups is to see how much one can say about a locally compact topological group by exploiting its measure theoretic structure only.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'μ': 'Haar measure on X', 'X': 'locally compact topological group', 'g ∈ X': 'group element'}
primitives.assumptions: X is locally compact and Hausdorff; μ is left-invariant under group action.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When X lacks local compactness or μ fails to be invariant under left translation.

layer2.mapping: Haar measure provides a canonical kernel for integrating over group manifolds in GSE's state transition dynamics.
